entries.17190e90a00c8c48: This business manufactures and sells, and performs installation work for, automatic fire alarm equipment, environmental monitoring systems, fire doors, smoke control equipment and other products. entries.448ffa4e603acaf7: The company's corporate motto is "Devote ourselves to the mission of a pioneer in the disaster-prevention business and contribute to public safety", and its management philosophy is to continue providing disaster-prevention systems to protect lives and property from disasters, under an integrated structure from research and development through maintenance.
